method: Actual vision interpretation of supplied concept, supplied photographic savanna screenshot and retained R2 comparison before implementation
landscapeObservations: Concept near/middle grass connects into luminous amber/gold masses; R2 remains olive/mustard in places and its added near-distance hills dominate the inspection silhouette.
The reference plain has shallow rolling changes under a large sky; cooler distant geology supplies most of the strong relief and separation.
Sharp seed/blade accents are selective; the retained broad strips repeat at similar scale and lean, competing with the desired continuous field.

inferencesNotObservedFacts: A declarative scaffold/secondary/terminal growth graph may reproduce those relations; the image itself does not reveal a generation algorithm.
Branch-owned low leaf sprays may connect lobes without spherical masses; attachment, overlap and shading must be rendered independently.
The provided palette is pigment guidance, not promised display pixels under ACES and scene lighting.
scope: Opt-in visual models only; same ecological identities, positions and seeds. Universal path ownership/taper/value hierarchy are separated from umbrella-acacia-specific branching/crown profiles. No measured botanical growth simulation claimed.
